implementation_approach: Hybrid - Escape special chars + Improve error messages
rationale: Escaping Tantivy operators allows HTML/XSS-like queries to work while preserving boolean query functionality. Fallback remains for index issues.

details.escaping_rule: Prepend backslash to special chars (except when part of valid boolean operator)
details.return: Escaped query string safe for Tantivy parsing

steps.task: Update search_index() to use sanitized query

details.change: Call sanitize_query() before passing to QueryParser
details.error_handling: Improve error messages to indicate what was sanitized

details.update: Verify sanitized queries now work, update error message assertions

success_criteria: Boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT) still work correctly
Error messages are specific when parsing fails
New tests cover sanitization edge cases

sanitize_query.postcondition: Returned string has all Tantivy special chars escaped
sanitize_query.invariant: Query semantics preserved for boolean operators

search_index.postcondition: Tantivy QueryParser succeeds or returns specific error

edge_case_handling.boolean_operators: rust AND python -> rust AND python (no escape needed)
edge_case_handling.mixed: rust & systems OR <tag> -> rust \& systems OR \<tag\>

backwards_compatibility: Breaking - Changes query parsing behavior, but improves UX
testing_strategy: Unit tests for sanitization + Integration tests for search behavior
